title: Weak-Curvature AMISE and Plug-in Bandwidth Selection for Kernel Density Estimation
summary: Kernel density estimation risk expansions are commonly expressed through the integrated squared curvature term that enters second-order AMISE and plug-in bandwidth rules. This paper develops a weak-curvature formulation of this classical calculation for densities whose second derivative exists weakly rather than as a continuous classical function.
